steps.name: Proposed gate compiles and reaches a verdict
steps.run:
gate=scripts/gate/spec_gate.py
for required in "$gate" .github/workflows/spec-gate.yml .github/workflows/registry-check.yml .githooks/pre-commit; do
  if ! git cat-file -e "$HEAD_SHA:$required" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "::error::$required is missing from this PR's head; the gate and its workflows cannot be removed by a PR" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
# git runs a configured hook only when it is executable; a mode change to 100644
# would silently switch the commit-time gate off.
# no pipe: the base gate counts a command only where its status is the statement's
mode=$(git ls-tree "$HEAD_SHA" .githooks/pre-commit)
mode=${mode%% *}
if [ "$mode" != "100755" ]; then
  echo "::error::.githooks/pre-commit has mode $mode at the head; the hook must stay executable (100755)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
# An executable hook that no longer calls the gate is the gate switched off for
# every clone with core.hooksPath set; the call must be live, not a comment.
if ! git show "$HEAD_SHA:.githooks/pre-commit" | grep -Ev '^[[:space:]]*(#|echo |printf |: )' | grep -Eq 'scripts/gate/spec_gate\.py"?[[:space:]]+--commit'; then
  echo "::error::.githooks/pre-commit at the head no longer runs scripts/gate/spec_gate.py --commit" >&2
  exit 1
fi
python3 -m pip install --quiet pyyaml
python3 -m py_compile "$gate"
# `A && B || C` keeps errexit on while capturing the status; `set +e` would let a later
# `true` hide any failure, which the base gate refuses
out=$(python3 "$gate" --pr "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA" 2>&1) && rc=0 || rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$out"
if [ "$rc" -gt 1 ] || ! printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qE '^(spec gate ok|SPEC GATE FAILED)'; then
  echo "::error::the proposed $gate exited $rc without a verdict; it would break the gate for every later PR" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "proposed gate reached a verdict (exit $rc); the base gate's verdict is the one that counts"

steps.name: Proposed gate passes its own suite
steps.run:
suite=tests/scripts/test_spec_gate.py
if git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA:$suite" 2>/dev/null && ! git cat-file -e "$HEAD_SHA:$suite" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "::error::$suite exists on the base but this PR removes it; the proposed gate cannot be accepted untested" >&2
  exit 1
fi
python3 -m pip install --quiet pytest pyyaml
# Unconditional: the suite is a gate entrypoint the PR cannot remove, and the base
# gate accepts a contract command only in a statement that always runs. This is the
# PR's own suite; the base's suite judges the proposed gate in spec-gate.yml.
# --noconftest: the suite is hermetic; a repository conftest may import packages this job does not install
python3 -m pytest tests/scripts/test_spec_gate.py -q -p no:cacheprovider --noconftest
